reply_text:
Vantorre Group changed hands from you on 4 May 2026. Moss's Sunday prep dated 3 May says it "changes hands tomorrow, 2026-05-04." The 4 May digest to Ruth confirms it. It says your old industrial account was reassigned in the CRM effective that day.

Vantorre Mobility, the subsidiary, is a separate account. It went to Gideon Sato on the same day.
